usage: sfx [-c <context>]                         open a saved context (default: the active one)
       sfx <endpoint> [--auth <methods>] [options]  open a cluster directly
       sfx context <command>                       manage saved contexts

  <endpoint>              host, host:port or URL (default port 19080)
  --auth <methods>        auth methods, applied in order (default: none)
  --refresh <seconds>     auto-refresh interval, 0 to disable (default: 5)
  --readonly              hide every action that changes the cluster
  --power                 unlock the riskiest actions (also :power in the UI)
  --version               print the version

contexts:
  sfx context list
  sfx context add <name> <endpoint> [--auth <methods>] [auth options] [--readonly | --power] [--use]
  sfx context use <name>
  sfx context show [<name>]
  sfx context remove <name>

auth methods:
  none       unsecured cluster
  cert       X.509 client certificate
      --cert-thumbprint <value>    client certificate thumbprint, looked up in the certificate store
      --cert-store <value>         CurrentUser (default) or LocalMachine
      --cert-file <value>          client certificate from a .pfx or .pem file
      --server-thumbprint <value>  expected cluster certificate thumbprint (repeatable)
      --server-cn <value>          expected cluster certificate common name (repeatable)
  aad        Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), device code sign-in
      --server-thumbprint <value>  expected cluster certificate thumbprint (repeatable)
      --server-cn <value>          expected cluster certificate common name (repeatable)
  windows    Windows (Kerberos) as the current user
  claims-command claims token from an external command
      --token-command <value>      program that reads the cluster's token-service metadata as JSON on stdin and prints the token
      --interactive                allow a sign-in prompt (the first time, and when a silent sign-in fails)
      --server-thumbprint <value>  expected cluster certificate thumbprint (repea
